question:
The following bar graph shows exports of cars of type A and B (in Rs. millions) from 2014 to 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e2cc78d53a992dbc9a1e993477fcb9f7eb214b82e16e902e14d5f026ca22f04.png] 

What is the ratio of the total exports of cars of type A in 2014 and 2017 to the total exports of cars of type B in 2015 and 2016?
solution:
**Given:**

The total exports of cars of type A and B (in Rs. millions) from 2014 to 2018 are shown in the bar graph.

**Calculation:**

Total exports of cars of type A in 2014 and 2017 = 200 + 175 = 375

The total exports of cars of type B in 2015 and 2016 = 250 + 200 = 450

The ratio = 375 : 450 = 5 : 6

**∴ The ratio of the total exports of cars of type A in 2014 and 2017 to the total exports of cars of type B in 2015 and 2016 is 5 : 6**
